ZinOSBrix.NativeFirst: brixOS may use its own handle, wait, memory-map, process and IPC primitives.
ZinOSBrix.PosixFacade: std.posix translates required POSIX semantics onto brixOS native primitives.
ZinOSBrix.WaylandTransport: brixOS must provide a Wayland-capable byte-stream transport with ancillary handle/fd passing semantics, shared memory object export/import, and poll/wait integration. The public Zin Wayland API remains identical across Linux, BSD and brixOS.
